summary: The diff changes the prompt rendering logic in `prompt()` and `confirm()` to split the prompt text at the last character boundary instead of stripping all trailing spaces and appending a space. This correctly handles empty `prompt_suffix` values while still satisfying the readline backspace workaround (issues #665 and #2092). The change is logically consistent: `text[:-1]` is echoed with `err=err`, and `text[-1:]` is passed to the input function (which writes to stdout). All existing test assertions remain satisfied since for the default `prompt_suffix=": "`, the last character is a space, producing identical output. New test cases correctly verify the empty suffix behavior. The approach is sound and well-tested.
